MANDIANT_VULN_CVES.description: Optional CSV of CVE ids to fetch via the Mandiant Vulnerability Intelligence v4 surface (e.g. 'CVE-2024-1234, CVE-2023-5678'). When supplied, the executor walks the list in order and issues one HTTP GET per CVE against /v4/vulnerability/{cve_id} — duplicates are deduped case-insensitively, whitespace is trimmed, and malformed entries (must match CVE-YYYY-N+) are dropped with a warning so a single typo doesn't abort the run. When both MANDIANT_VULN_CVES and MANDIANT_INDICATOR_LIST are supplied, the executor walks both lists in turn and emits one Faraday vulnerability per record from each. When neither is supplied the executor still exchanges credentials for an OAuth2 Bearer token (so misconfiguration surfaces immediately) and emits an empty Faraday document.

MANDIANT_INDICATOR_LIST.description: Optional CSV of typed indicators to fetch via the Mandiant Indicators-of-Compromise v4 surface (e.g. 'md5:abcd1234..., ip:198.51.100.1, fqdn:malicious.example.com, sha256:..., url:https://malicious.example.com/path'). Each entry must be 'type:value'; accepted types are md5, sha1, sha256, ip (alias for ipv4), ipv4, ipv6, fqdn (alias for domain), domain, url. Duplicates are deduped case-insensitively against the canonical type + raw value pair, whitespace is trimmed, and malformed / blank / unknown-type entries are dropped with a warning so a single typo doesn't abort the run. The executor walks the list in order and issues one HTTP GET per indicator against /v4/indicator/{type}/{value} — URL encoding is applied automatically so URL indicators round-trip cleanly.

name: mandiant
title: Mandiant Advantage Threat Intelligence
description: Mandiant Advantage Threat Intelligence importer. Pulls vulnerability + indicator records from the canonical Mandiant Advantage v4 REST surface (https://api.intelligence.mandiant.com/v4/...) and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Two operational modes via the manifest args, freely combinable in a single run: (1) MANDIANT_VULN_CVES (CSV of CVE ids) walks the list in order and issues one HTTP GET per CVE via /v4/vulnerability/{cve_id}; invalid-shaped entries are dropped silently. (2) MANDIANT_INDICATOR_LIST (CSV of 'type:value' typed indicators — md5 | sha1 | sha256 | ip | ipv4 | ipv6 | fqdn | domain | url) walks the list in order and issues one HTTP GET per indicator via /v4/indicator/{type}/{value}. Each Mandiant record becomes one Faraday vulnerability under a single synthetic 0.0.0.0 host with hostname 'mandiant' (Mandiant entries are CVE / IOC keyed not host-keyed — the operator's other agents emit the host-side findings this feed is correlated against). Vuln entries carry the [MANDIANT] engine prefix on the name; indicator entries carry the [MANDIANT IOC] prefix so operators can filter the two streams independently. Every Faraday vuln carries tags: ['mandiant'] and surfaces the Mandiant risk rating, exploitation state, CVSS, vulnerable products, threat actors, malware families (for vuln entries) plus the mscore (Mandiant Confidence Score 0..100), first / last seen, attributed associations, categories, and sources (for indicator entries) in both the description and the refs list so the operator can pivot from a Faraday finding back to the canonical Mandiant Advantage detail page. Vulnerability severity is bucketed via the explicit risk_rating text (CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW) when present, falling back to CVSSv3 baseSeverity text then numeric baseScore bucketing (>=9.0 critical / >=7.0 high / >=4.0 medium / >0.0 low / 0.0 info). Records flagged exploitation_state: 'Wild' (active in-the-wild exploitation observed by Mandiant analysts) are bumped to critical regardless of the rating ladder. Indicator severity is bucketed from the Mandiant mscore (>=80 critical / >=50 high / >=25 medium / >=10 low / <10 info). Unscored CVEs / indicators default to 'info'. Refs include the canonical NVD CVE permalink (for vuln entries), the Mandiant Advantage vulnerability-detail / indicator-detail page permalinks, every vendor_fix_references URL, and explicit Mandiant-CveID / Mandiant-RiskRating / Mandiant-ExploitationState / Mandiant-ExploitationConsequence / Mandiant-Cvss* / Mandiant-ZeroDay / Mandiant-InTheWild / Mandiant-Product / Mandiant-ThreatActor / Mandiant-Malware / Mandiant-AuditPublishDate / Mandiant-AuditUpdateDate / Mandiant-IndicatorType / Mandiant-IndicatorValue / Mandiant-Mscore / Mandiant-ThreatRating / Mandiant-FirstSeen / Mandiant-LastSeen / Mandiant-LastUpdated / Mandiant-Assoc-* / Mandiant-Category / Mandiant-Source pivots. Status is always open (a Mandiant record cannot be 'fixed' in the catalog — it can only be remediated on the affected hosts). Auth: MANDIANT_KEY_ID + MANDIANT_KEY_SECRET are both mandatory and are exchanged via OAuth2 client_credentials (HTTP Basic at POST /token, grant_type=client_credentials) for a short-lived (~1h) Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer ... on every subsequent request. MANDIANT_HOST may optionally be overridden via env to point at a federated mirror or an offline cache; defaults to https://api.intelligence.mandiant.com. Tags: [mandiant].
